data.description: 【星野爱 · 剧场公演】剧场公演的舞台上，星野爱换上露肩粉裙与蓝领结，手指轻点唇边抛出一个飞吻，白丝与黑鞋在追光下划出利落的弧线——「这份心意，要好好收下哦。」
data.promptProse: On the theater stage, Ai touches her fingers to her lips to send a kiss while holding the performance microphone. Her off-shoulder pink dress, blue necktie and white thighhighs remain in the dynamic cowboy view, black shoes aligned with her turning step. The stage falls away behind her into dark wings. A following spotlight illuminates her face and skirt edge, with other stage lights glancing along the microphone casing.
data.title: 星野爱 · 剧场公演
